contract: A23-1 / GDD 0-2: auto combat starts OFF and locked; UnlockAutoCombat only sets AutoCombatUnlocked; the player toggles AutoCombatEnabled (saved via SetStat); auto attacks and auto skills hit monsters only.
coverage: defaults AutoCombatUnlocked/AutoCombatEnabled false and mirrored; exactly one loop at Config.Combat.AutoTick
legacy AutoAttack attribute, unlock alone and repeated unlock never start auto combat
SetAutoAttack: one boolean only, unlocked/ready/alive/class-chosen, rate limited, saved through SetStat
auto stops when OFF, not unlocked, dead, no root, not ready, left, class not chosen, kaiju Active/Siren/Queued
no monster in reach: no swing, no skill, no MP
auto skill: MP cost and 3 s cooldown, Released Auto=true with MonstersHit, never MarkActive
manual swing makes auto yield SwingInterval + ManualYieldPad (Warrior/Mage/Archer)
auto Swing/Release (loop and direct calls) never damage players or an Active kaiju for Around/Splash/Multi, Halo and Horns attackers, PvP allowed; manual positive control does hit them
KaijuService Released handler ignores info.Auto heals (real handler source extracted)
static: AutoCombatEnabled written only by the SetAutoAttack toggle, AutoCombatUnlocked only by CombatService.UnlockAutoCombat (StoryQuestService unlock calls it), no client caller
limitations: Offline service/physics doubles; real client toggle UI, the unlock quest, animation timing, multiplayer and Studio play are not certified here.
